onboarding.welcomeDesc: Edge-Drop lives hidden on the left edge of your screen. Simply move your mouse to the left edge to open the panel, and move away to hide it.
onboarding.collectDesc: Whenever you press Ctrl+C to copy text, images, or files, Edge-Drop automatically catches and saves them in the background.
onboarding.dragDesc: Need to use an item? Just open the panel and drag the card directly into any application, folder, or document.
onboarding.stacksDesc: Copying multiple files groups them into a stack. You can drag the entire stack, or click it to view and extract individual files.
onboarding.ungroupDesc: Want to separate items in a stack? Click to expand the stack, then drag any subitem to the left edge of the screen. A glowing coral bar will appear—drop the item on it to extract it back into a standalone card.
onboarding.mergeDesc: Combine separate file or image cards by dragging them directly onto each other. This organizes your shelf by bundling related assets into a stack.
onboarding.previewDesc: Click the preview button on any card to open a side flyout. Inspect high-resolution images, browse file collections, read long text snippets, or drag items directly from the preview.
onboarding.configDesc: Customize how Edge-Drop works for you.
onboarding.dropToExtract: Drop to extract back into a standalone card
onboarding.proTip1: Press Alt + C to instantly toggle the shelf.
onboarding.proTip2: Access settings anytime via the gear icon (top right).
onboarding.proTip3: Drag & drop files to the left edge to add them.
onboarding.proTip4: Click a text box, then a clipboard item to auto-paste.

tray.welcomeBody: Hover against the middle-left screen edge, or press Alt+C to slide open your shelf.
